GBR.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

_meta.title: Minority and Indigenous language rights: UN findings by country
_meta.what: For each country, how many UN human-rights recommendations and observations (from the treaty bodies, the special procedures and the Universal Periodic Review) deal with the rights of linguistic minorities and Indigenous peoples to use, learn and be served in their own languages, with every matching record listed in full. value = number of matching records. This counts UN attention, not the size of the problem: countries that report more often, or receive more country visits, get more records, and a country with no record may simply not have been reviewed on the issue. A record about several countries is listed under each. year = latest record; first_year = earliest.
_meta.matching_rule: Text mentions minority language(s), languages of minorities, mother tongue, language rights, linguistic minorities/rights/groups/communities/diversity, Indigenous language(s), regional languages, sign language, language barriers, or "in their own language(s)". Matching is on the English text of each UHRI record (plus UHRI tags where stated); every record that matches is kept. Field "matched" shows what matched in each record.
_meta.source: Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR), Universal Human Rights Index, full dataset export (export-full-en.xlsx, 278244 records, downloaded 2026-10-22)
_meta.licence: OHCHR: dataset shared "freely and without any restriction to the public"
_meta.licence_quote: "OHCHR is willing to share freely and without any restriction to the public the dataset from UHRI" (https://uhri.ohchr.org/en/our-data-api)
_meta.citation: OHCHR, Universal Human Rights Index (uhri.ohchr.org), full dataset export, accessed 2026-10-22.
_meta.note_codes: XKX = Kosovo (UHRI: "Kosovo*"); EUU = European Union (not a country; UHRI lists it as a country concerned).
_meta.document_url_note: document_url is the UN Official Document System link built from the document symbol.
_meta.records_note: This layer was over 4 MB, so each country lists record_ids and the full records (all fields, with text) are in un_minority_language_records.json, keyed by annotation_id, stored once even when a record concerns several countries. No record was dropped.
